title: Dutch Cities are Better for the Environment (and my sanity)
summary: Not Just Bikes explains why living in a dense, bikeable Dutch city sharply reduced his family's environmental footprint and improved quality of life. It is a collaboration that continues on Climate Town.
why: HN cites it in threads on sprawl, density, and climate, especially for the point that everything is a short bike ride from downtown Amsterdam.

quote.text: These are pretty snarky, but fun videos and the authors list their sources.
